channel.title: Blowhorn Resources: Overview
channel.description: Everything in Blowhorn Resources tagged Overview.

item.title: Remote team, one army
item.description: Every teammate runs Blowhorn on their own computer, signed in as themselves. You see the whole fleet and every result in one place.

item.title: Not a bot. It's you.
item.description: Platforms are done with bots. Blowhorn isn't one: it's you, on your own computers, under your own profiles, with your people beside you and you in command.

item.title: Beyond the API
item.description: Platform APIs keep some actions for approved partners. Blowhorn works the way you do, so it isn't limited to what those APIs expose.

item.title: Battalion Thunder
item.description: From one recruit to one thunder: install Blowhorn on as many computers as you like, they fall in as one unit, and one order goes out to every channel at once.
